meta.title: Gardens & Parks
meta.description: The lawns, palm-lined avenues and walking paths of the 47-acre XLRI Delhi-NCR campus — a green campus with a platinum-level IGBC Green Building Certification.

title: Gardens & Parks
intro: Lawns, palm-lined avenues and walking paths open up the 47-acre campus — room to walk, play and pause between classes.

photos.alt: A wide lawn with the red “I ♥ XLRI” sign, the academic blocks behind
The lawn in front of the academic block, with benches along its edge
A student kicking a ball on the open grass field beside a goalpost
Palms and a planted median at the campus main gate

highlights.title: A green campus
highlights.text: The 47-acre campus was designed to promote eco-friendly living, and holds a platinum-level Green Building Certification to IGBC guidelines.

highlights.title: Open lawns
highlights.text: Wide lawns stretch between the academic blocks and the hostel, with space for an evening game of football.

highlights.title: Walking paths
highlights.text: Paved paths wind through the grounds, lined with lamp posts and young trees.

photos.alt: Hedges and lawns along the approach to the main gate
A curving path around a lawn at dusk
Two paved paths meeting between lawns, lined with lamp posts
Students gathered for a photograph on the central lawn
